recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Department of Field Support establish a mechanism to monitor compliance with the requirement of obtaining clearance from the Global Service Centre by the missions prior to sourcing non-expendable assets. There should be clear binding instructions to ensure adherence to the policy of sourcing non-expendable assets only after obtaining clearance from the Centre.
